title: On Abandoning the old plan
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：abandon　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 abandon 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the musician ① abandoned the old plan for the whole place, and every listener in the hall said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the musician ② abandons the old plan without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ abandon the old plan at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ abandoned the old plan before — a line in the programme for December 1973 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Abandoning the old plan for the whole place, the musician said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ abandon the hill village without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Abandon the hill village at once and never mention it again.

By 1986 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new listener from the next hall ⑧ abandons the hill village for the whole place every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the piano, said nothing at all; she simply  abandoned the old plan again when nobody else would.

To abandon the old plan, my mother said in 1991, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the hall remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the hall forgets, somebody abandons the old plan without a word of thanks again and somebody must abandon the old plan for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 放弃（一般过去式 abandoned the old plan：1979 年乐师头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 放弃（一般现在 abandons the old plan：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 放弃（不定式 to abandon the old plan：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 放弃（过去完成时 had abandoned the old plan：1973 年十二月的节目单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 放弃（动名词 abandoning the old plan 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 丢下（abandon the hill village：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去丢下那个山村）
G. v. 丢下（abandon the hill village：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 放弃（后段两处：新来的听客照例 abandons the hill village，而母亲又一次 abandoned the old plan）

items.q: abandon the hill village without a word of thanks
abandon the hill village at once
abandons the hill village for the whole place

answers.why: abandon 意为“放弃”，1979 年乐师替所有人放弃那个旧计划，那是音乐厅里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 abandoned。
abandon 意为“放弃”，自那以后乐师不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 abandons。
abandon 意为“放弃”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯放弃那个旧计划”，此处为不定式 to abandon the old plan。
abandon 意为“放弃”，节目单里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1986 年之前就有人放弃过，故用过去完成时 had abandoned。
abandon 意为“放弃”，乐师说“放弃那个旧计划这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 abandoning the old plan 作主语。
abandon 意为“丢下”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去丢下那个山村”，should ever 之后用原形 abandon the hill village。
abandon 意为“丢下”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻丢下那个山村（abandon the hill village at once），以后再也不要提起。
abandon 意为“放弃”，新来的听客每个夜晚都照例丢下那个山村，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 abandons。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，乐师替所有人放弃那个旧计划；音乐厅里每一个听客都说这是头一回。（abandoned the old plan）
多年以后，乐师仍不图一句谢做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（abandons the old plan）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯放弃那个旧计划这件事本身。（to abandon the old plan）
早在 1973 年就有人放弃那个旧计划，十二月那天节目单上的一行字就是证据。（had abandoned the old plan）
乐师说过，替所有人放弃那个旧计划这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（abandoning the old plan 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻丢下那个山村，以后再也不要提起。（abandon the hill village，祈使句）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 abandon 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the musician abandoned the old plan for the whole place, and nobody in the hall forgot it.
Even now the musician abandons the old plan without a word of thanks whenever the hall asks.
Abandoning the old plan for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever abandon the hill village without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next hall abandons the hill village for the whole place every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother abandoned the old plan again, and the hall remembered that half.
